title: Decision runs record model, seed and prompt version, and a replay matches
objective: Each decision run records the context needed to replay it, and a run marked as a replay gives the same outcome as the run it replays.
acceptance_criteria: Scope: any run records gen_ai.request.seed, agentest.prompt.version, agentest.context.ids or agentest.replay.of (root or chat span). Pass: every run records a model (gen_ai.request.model or gen_ai.response.model), gen_ai.request.seed, agentest.prompt.version and agentest.context.ids, and each run with agentest.replay.of=<trace id> has the same gen_ai.evaluation.score.label as the referenced run (or, when a label is missing, the same final answer). Fail: a missing field on any run, or a replay whose outcome differs from its original. n/a: out of scope, or a replay names a trace id that is not in the set.

title: Trials of one task start from a clean environment
objective: Each trial of a task starts from the declared start state, and no trial reads an artefact written by an earlier trial of that task. Builders need this so a repeated run is not judged on leftover state from the trial before it.
acceptance_criteria: For runs that share a task id: Pass: every trial declares the same agentest.task.initial_state, and no trial reads an artefact ref (agentest.environment.change) written by an earlier trial. Fail: the initial state differs or is missing on a trial, or a later trial reads an earlier trial's ref. n/a: no initial state is declared.

title: All trials of a consistency-critical task succeed
objective: A skill the team marks as consistency-critical must succeed on every recorded trial, not only on a share of them. This is an all-trials gate beside the existing success-rate threshold.
acceptance_criteria: When an AgentCard skill sets consistency_required with k: Pass: at least k trials linked to that skill are recorded and every one of them meets its postconditions. Fail: fewer than k trials are recorded, or any linked trial does not meet its postconditions. n/a: no skill declares consistency_required with k, or no trial is linked to such a skill.

title: Tool errors and repeated calls stay within the declared budget
objective: Tool errors and identical repeated calls for one task, counted across its trials, stay inside the budgets the team declared. A rejected call recorded on the tool span counts, including an invalid-argument result.
acceptance_criteria: Per task, across its trials: Pass: tool spans with error.type, an error status, or an invalid-argument result stay within agentest.task.budget.tool_errors, and identical (name, arguments) calls after the first stay within agentest.task.budget.repeat_calls. Each budget is checked only when it is declared. Fail: a count is over its budget, or the trials declare different numbers for one budget. n/a: neither budget is declared.

title: Privacy-violation alert fires within the declared detection window
objective: After a privacy fault is injected, the monitoring system raises an alert about it quickly enough that the declared detection window is met, so a privacy violation is not left undetected.
acceptance_criteria: Scope: runs that declare agentest.task.detect_within_s and contain a span with agentest.fault.injected=true and agentest.fault.kind exploit. Pass: each such fault is followed by an agentest.alert record (span, span event or log record) whose agentest.alert.ref equals agentest.fault.id and whose start time is within agentest.task.detect_within_s of the fault. Fail: no matching alert, or the first matching alert starts later than the window. n/a: no injected privacy fault, or agentest.task.detect_within_s is missing.

title: Malformed or oversized inputs are rejected or sanitized before a write
objective: When an input is malformed, oversized or badly encoded, the agent must reject it or sanitize it before any state-changing tool call succeeds, so a bad input is never written through.
acceptance_criteria: Scope: runs that declare agentest.input.families with one of malformed, oversized or bad_encoding, on the run root or on a user-input span. Pass: agentest.input.sanitized is true before the first state-changing tool call, or no state-changing tool call succeeds. Fail: a state-changing tool call succeeds before any sanitization. n/a: no malformed, oversized or bad-encoding input family is declared.
